source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Loading an event sets the preview calendar-name text; clearing preview data clears it with the event title. The original patch places a screen-reader-only calendar-name span beside event-title inside the heading and adds a direct test for the name and reset. The accepted later layout puts the name in a separate titlebar span and adds a title tooltip, so that later structure is not credited to the initial patch. The two name assertions establish text/reset expectations in test code. They do not assert a screen-reader announcement, full accessible name or visual rendering. No fresh browser test or accessibility run.
title: The Calendar preview sets and clears calendar-name text with event data
